checks.name: merged CLI and active-test deadline checks

scope: Master integration preserves the declared generation implementation scope, including the Go toolchain module declarations, model-family runtimes, shared graph/math/tensor/media code and CUDA kernels. The merged CLI/deadline and retained-evidence checks were acquired on the staged source before the merge commit. The merge gate validates the complete staged candidate separately. Exact Wan/SenseNova generation outputs are reused from their recorded source revisions; no new generation timing or visual-quality claim is made. The live selected catalog must retain all frozen media model/recipe/input bindings. Unrelated master text capability work is outside this media denominator. Full temporal visual review and broader public-workflow cases remain open.
